item.title: Pitcher of perseverance: After decade in the minors, Westbury’s Seelinger gets shot with Tigers
item.description: After a decade of grinding through the minor leagues, Westbury native right-handed reliever Matt Seelinger is finally getting his shot. Now 30 years old, Seelinger has earned a spring training roster invite with the Detroit Tigers in Lakeland, Fla. item.description: The Jericho Jayettes varsity dance team gave a well-received performance for Senior Night during a recent boys varsity basketball game. item.title: Editorial: Celebrating Black History Month in Nassau
item.description: Black History Month offers Nassau County an opportunity not only to reflect on the past, but to appreciate how deeply the national story of civil rights is woven into our own communities. item.title: The Hole in Fire Island Inlet Bridge Becomes a Lightning Rod for Political Controversy
item.description: Days before the blizzard, a Feb. 20 video showing a hole in the Fire Island Inlet Bridge's roadway went viral. The hole was large enough to reveal the rushing current of the Great South Bay 60 feet below, with only the exposed bar grating remaining in between. Now, elected officials are sounding the alarm.…
